title: What's new
items: Extended import compatibility for backup containers and improved document/folder mapping updates across repeated imports.
Improved overlay rendering pipeline for handwriting, image annotations, and shape annotations.
Added annotated PDF export improvements so overlays are preserved in downloads.
Added advanced ink/shape debug controls with persistent defaults for decode mode, stroke width, and rendering diagnostics.
Added parser-version based update detection so re-importing updates existing documents after parser/rendering changes.
Form rendering improvements are currently beta: line, arrow, rectangle, pentagon, circle, and spline handling has been significantly improved but is still being fine-tuned.
